_about: Public-domain A. T. Robertson (Archibald Thomas Robertson, 1863-1934), Southern Baptist Greek scholar, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930, among them A Grammar of the Greek New Testament in the Light of Historical Research (copyright 1914), A Harmony of the Gospels (1922), Epochs in the Life of Jesus (1907) and of St. Paul (1909), the Life and Letters of John Albert Broadus (1901), Luke the Historian (1920), The Pharisees and Jesus (1920) and The Wisdom of James (1915), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Not James Craigie Robertson or F. W. Robertson. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
